<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_cmdbgov_app.CMDBGovConfig</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Reads CMDB Governance configuration from x_cmdbgov_app.* system properties.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CMDBGovConfig</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>/**
 * CMDBGovConfig
 * Reads the CMDB Governance configuration from system properties
 * (all prefixed with "x_cmdbgov_app.") and returns a plain object.
 *
 * Scope: x_cmdbgov_app   Access: This application scope only
 */
var CMDBGovConfig = Class.create();

CMDBGovConfig.PREFIX = 'x_cmdbgov_app.';

CMDBGovConfig.DEFAULT_CLASSES =
    'cmdb_ci_server,cmdb_ci_appl,cmdb_ci_db_instance,cmdb_ci_service_auto,cmdb_ci_business_app';

CMDBGovConfig.DEFAULT_REQUIRED = JSON.stringify({
    '_default': ['name', 'owned_by', 'support_group', 'assignment_group', 'install_status', 'operational_status'],
    'cmdb_ci_server': ['ip_address', 'os', 'serial_number', 'location'],
    'cmdb_ci_appl': ['version'],
    'cmdb_ci_db_instance': ['version'],
    'cmdb_ci_business_app': ['it_application_owner', 'business_criticality'],
    'cmdb_ci_service_auto': ['busines_criticality']
});

CMDBGovConfig.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    _prop: function(name, defaultValue) {
        var v = gs.getProperty(CMDBGovConfig.PREFIX + name, '');
        if (v === null || v === undefined || String(v).trim() === '')
            return defaultValue;
        return String(v).trim();
    },

    _int: function(name, defaultValue) {
        var n = parseInt(this._prop(name, String(defaultValue)), 10);
        return isNaN(n) || n <= 0 ? defaultValue : n;
    },

    /**
     * @returns {Object} configuration object used by the data source and engine
     */
    get: function() {
        var classes = this._prop('classes', CMDBGovConfig.DEFAULT_CLASSES)
            .split(',')
            .map(function(s) { return s.trim(); })
            .filter(function(s) { return s.length > 0; });

        var required;
        var requiredError = '';
        try {
            required = JSON.parse(this._prop('required_fields', CMDBGovConfig.DEFAULT_REQUIRED));
        } catch (e) {
            requiredError = 'Property x_cmdbgov_app.required_fields is not valid JSON; defaults used.';
            gs.warn('[CMDB Governance] ' + requiredError);
            required = JSON.parse(CMDBGovConfig.DEFAULT_REQUIRED);
        }

        var authType = this._prop('remote.auth_type', 'basic').toLowerCase();
        if (authType !== 'oauth2')
            authType = 'basic';

        return {
            dataSource: this._prop('data_source', 'local').toLowerCase() === 'remote' ? 'remote' : 'local',
            remoteUrl: this._prop('remote.instance_url', '').replace(/\/+$/, ''),
            authType: authType,
            authProfile: this._prop('remote.auth_profile', ''),
            classes: classes,
            scopeQuery: this._prop('scope_query', 'install_status!=7'),
            staleDays: this._int('stale_days', 90),
            required: required,
            requiredError: requiredError,
            drilldownLimit: this._int('drilldown_limit', 100),
            duplicateGroupLimit: this._int('duplicate_group_limit', 500)
        };
    },

    type: 'CMDBGovConfig'
};
</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-18 04:54:05</sys_created_on><sys_id>8dffdede69ea5e4992d355492ae1c457</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-18 04:54:05</sys_updated_on><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_8dffdede69ea5e4992d355492ae1c457</sys_update_name><sys_package display_value="CMDB Governance" source="x_cmdbgov_app">1a9f4ea4623358e6ab416ae78953397e</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="CMDB Governance">1a9f4ea4623358e6ab416ae78953397e</sys_scope></sys_script_include></record_update>
